The '''Sedrian religion''' was a religion based on the worship of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] [[Coral/Legends|coral]] communal intelligence known as the [[Golden Sun]]. The native [[Sedrian]]s worshipped Golden Sun, and built a [[Great Shell Dome|dome]] to house its [[Sun caves]] in the Sedrian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]]. The worship of Golden Sun was fundamental to Sedrian society, with the [[High Priest of the Golden Sun]] being the leader of all Sedrians.
